Google Search Incorrectly Reports OpenAI CEO Sam Altman Dead

Google search results incorrectly stated that OpenAI CEO Sam Altman was dead. The error appeared to stem from information on public sources that may have been vandalized. Google has not yet officially commented on the incident. This error occurred despite Google's efforts to improve search result accuracy.
